name: OCAP2 Web
author: ocap2@github.com
description: OCAP2 Web Server — archives and replays Arma 3 military simulation missions on interactive Leaflet maps. Provides a web interface for browsing operations, streaming playback, and mission upload via API.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

apt update
apt -y install --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates jq

## Determine architecture
ARCH=$([[ "$(uname -m)" == "x86_64" ]] && echo "amd64" || echo "arm64")

## Resolve version
if [ "${VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Fetching latest release version..."
    VERSION=$(curl -sSL https://api.github.com/repos/OCAP2/web/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name // empty')
    if [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
        echo "No stable release found, fetching latest pre-release..."
        VERSION=$(curl -sSL https://api.github.com/repos/OCAP2/web/releases | jq -r '.[0].tag_name // empty')
    fi
    if [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Could not determine latest version"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "Installing OCAP2 Web ${VERSION} for ${ARCH}..."

DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/OCAP2/web/releases/download/${VERSION}/ocap-webserver-linux-${ARCH}.tar.gz"

## Download and extract
cd /mnt/server
curl -sSL -o ocap-webserver.tar.gz "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
tar -xzf ocap-webserver.tar.gz --strip-components=1
rm -f ocap-webserver.tar.gz
chmod +x ocap-webserver

## Create data directories if they don't exist
mkdir -p data db maps

echo "Installation complete: OCAP2 Web ${VERSION}"

variables.name: OCAP Secret
variables.description: Shared secret for mission uploads and streaming authentication. Must be changed from the default.

variables.name: Listen Address
variables.description: Address and port the server binds to. Uses the Pelican-allocated port by default.

variables.name: Database Path
variables.description: Path to the SQLite database file.

variables.name: Data Directory
variables.description: Directory for mission data files (uploads and converted protobuf).

variables.name: Enable Conversion
variables.description: Enable background conversion of JSON missions to chunked protobuf format for faster streaming playback.

variables.name: Enable Streaming
variables.description: Enable the WebSocket streaming endpoint for live mission data ingestion from Arma 3.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: Release version to install (e.g. v2.1.0-rc7). Use 'latest' for the most recent release.
